description: This is a Java test class for the AddOnsFactory component in the AnySoftKeyboard project. It contains unit tests verifying the behavior of add-on factory creation, filtering, enabling/disabling add-ons, and configuration changes.

classes.name: AddOnsFactoryTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing AddOnsFactory behavior in the AnySoftKeyboard project.

classes.name: TestAddOn
classes.description: A mock implementation of AddOn used for testing AddOnsFactory.

classes.name: TestableAddOnsFactory
classes.description: A subclass of AddOnsFactory used for testing, with methods to simulate enabling/disabling add-ons.

classes.name: TestableSingleAddOnsFactory
classes.description: A subclass of AddOnsFactory.SingleAddOnsFactory used for testing single-selection add-on behavior.

classes.name: TestableMultiAddOnsFactory
classes.description: A subclass of AddOnsFactory.MultipleAddOnsFactory used for testing multi-selection add-on behavior.

methods.name: testMustSupplyPrefix
methods.description: Tests that creating an AddOnsFactory with an empty prefix throws IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: testMustSupplyBuiltInAddOnsList
methods.description: Tests that creating an AddOnsFactory without a built-in add-ons list throws IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: testMustSupplyNoneEmptyBuiltIns
methods.description: Tests that creating an AddOnsFactory with an empty built-in add-ons XML throws IllegalStateException.

methods.name: testGetAllAddOns
methods.description: Verifies that getAllAddOns returns a non-empty list with unique add-on IDs.

methods.name: testFiltersDebugAddOnOnReleaseBuilds
methods.description: Checks that debug add-ons are filtered out on release builds.

methods.name: testDoesNotFiltersDebugAddOnOnDebugBuilds
methods.description: Checks that debug add-ons are included on debug builds.

methods.name: testHiddenAddOnsAreNotReturned
methods.description: Ensures hidden add-ons are not included in the list of all add-ons but can be retrieved specifically.

methods.name: testGetAllAddOnsReturnsUnmodifiableList
methods.description: Verifies that the list returned by getAllAddOns is unmodifiable.

methods.name: testOnlyOneEnabledAddOnWhenSingleSelection
methods.description: Tests that only one add-on is enabled at a time in single-selection mode, and default fallback works.

methods.name: testManyEnabledAddOnWhenMultiSelection
methods.description: Tests enabling multiple add-ons in multi-selection mode and fallback behavior.

methods.name: testSetNewConfiguration
methods.description: Verifies that configuration changes update the package context of the enabled add-on.
